technology_name: EXTERNAL BEAM-COLUMN JOINT CONFIGURATION FOR A STEEL REINFORCED CONCRETE COLUMN AND A REINFORCED CONCRETE BEAM FOR ENHANCED SEISMIC BEHAVIOUR
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Seismic Structural Engineering / Structural Joint Hardware
problem_solved: Conventional beam-column connections in high-rise buildings suffer from extreme stress localization and rebar congestion during seismic shifting, causing catastrophic joint shearing failures.
description: An exterior structural joint assembly optimized for steel reinforced concrete (SRC) column configurations and reinforced concrete (RC) beams, minimizing internal column rebar clutter to enhance load-carrying capacity and dynamic energy dissipation.
applications: Earthquake-resistant high-rise building cores, smart city highway overpass pillars, heavy industrial facility frameworks, and coastal infrastructure retrofitting.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability
